hypotheses.O0_hosvd_baseline_matches_prior_result: The recomputed Euclidean HOSVD-16 baseline is within 0.01 of the prior head-split external fidelities.
hypotheses.O1_score_objective_improves_scores: Every score-optimized seed improves mean external prediction/target fidelity over HOSVD-16 by at least 0.02.
hypotheses.O2_all_objective_improves_margin: Every all-endpoint seed improves mean external margin fidelity over HOSVD-16 by at least 0.08.
hypotheses.O3_margin_gain_does_not_destroy_scores: Every all-endpoint seed retains at least 0.80 prediction and target fidelity on every external corpus.
hypotheses.O4_validation_selection_transfers: For both objectives, the seed with best validation objective is no worse than 0.03 below the best seed on the corresponding mean external objective.
hypotheses.O5_behavior_cores_are_seed_stable: Within each objective, the external objective range across seeds is at most 0.05.
hypotheses.O6_score_and_margin_cores_are_distinct: The best-validation score and all-endpoint cores have projector overlap below 0.90 in at least one tensor role.
hypotheses.O7_optimized_core_is_a_heldout_claim: Optimization uses only the first 192 discovery sites; the final 64 sites select checkpoints and all external corpora remain untouched until evaluation.
